messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] How to escape % in roxygen literate programming?
messages.subject_clean: [Roxygen-devel] How to escape % in roxygen literate programming?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

the default value of a parameter of my function contains a "%". This
seems to be a problem for roxygen, it produces a lot of warnings and R
CMD check fails when trying to build latex documentation.

How can I make this function (and its documentation) work? Using %% or
\% instead of % does not help.

    #' Test escape \% from in-source documentation (roxygen).
    #'
    #' What happens when parameters contain special latex characters?
    #'
    #' @param x unsuspicious parameter
    #' @param format sprintf format string (default "\%5.0f")
    #'
    #' @return formatted string
    #' @export
    #' @author Karsten Weinert
    testroxy <- function(x, format = "%5.0f") {
      sprintf(format,x)
    }

Any hint appreciated,
kind regards,

Karsten

messages.subject_clean: [Roxygen-devel] Can Roxygen work for S4 class
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I like Roxygen very much, I am just wondering if Roxygen work for S4
documentation.

Before I can just put the cursor on the function in Emcas and run
ess-roxy-update-entry to generate a list of document entry with #' right
before this function.

Since S4 defines one methods for many classes, and dispatch different
function, I don't know if Roxygen still work for this.

Thanks

Regards

Tengfei

messages.body_plain:
>> I like Roxygen very much, I am just wondering if Roxygen work for S4
>> documentation.
>
> Manuel added some support for this in the SVN version; Manuel, do you
> think it's time we made a release?

The version is already on CRAN; if you use use.Rd2 <- TRUE for the
roxygenize(...) function, then you have some (very basic) S4 support
(e.g. @slot, etc.).


Manuel.
